plan.summary: BRO-5261 retro-review of BRO-4790: the restored Islington Tribune review of The Last Ship (Drury Lane 2026) is still credited to "Unknown". The article byline reads "Friday, 2nd October — By Lucy Popescu" (live page https://www.islingtontribune.co.uk/article/review-the-last-ship-at-theatre-royal-drury-lane, checked 2026-10-14) and the stored fullText carries the same byline. No other Islington Tribune file exists for this show, so there is no double count.

actions.description: Byline on the live article and in the stored text: By Lucy Popescu (Friday, 2nd October 2026).
